items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 17 May 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry with sunny spells to start, then occasional showers in the afternoon that may merge into a longer spell of rain in the evening. Moderate to fresh west or southwest wind decreasing later. Maximum temperature 13°C.

Dry with bright or sunny spells to start tomorrow, then cloud increasing late afternoon ahead of an area of rain late evening and overnight into Tuesday. Light to moderate southwest wind backing southeast later and strengthening. Top temperature 13°C.


##Outlook##

Outbreaks of rain to start on Tuesday, this then clearing to showers and bright intervals. Fresh to strong southeast wind veering southwest and decreasing later. Highest temperature 14°C.
